mapper.select: SELECT c.no,c.board_no,c.member_id,m.name,c.msg,TO_CHAR(c.regdate,'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:mi:ss') AS dbday,c.parent_no,LEVEL-1 AS group_tab FROM free_comment c JOIN member m ON c.member_id=m.member_id WHERE board_no=#{no} START WITH parent_no IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR no=parent_no ORDER SIBLINGS BY no ASC
